metadata.title: Spiders AI | Customer Growth Marketing Hub
metadata.description: Unify social, website, CRM, product, and support signals in one customer growth workspace.

auth.title: One sign-in. Every customer signal.
auth.description: Connect channels, publish content, classify comments, and turn engagement into action.
auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
auth.signUpDescription: Create an account to start managing your channels.

landing.title: Catch every signal.
landing.description: Spiders AI brings publishing, customer conversations, demo analytics, and follow-up into one intelligent marketing workspace.
landing.workflowDescription: Every step maps directly to the MVP flow.
landing.generateText: Suggest an English or Arabic caption.
landing.followUpText: Turn the conversation into a task.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: A clear view of publishing, engagement, and follow-up work.
dashboard.signIn: Sign in again to load your workspace.
dashboard.headline: From content to follow-up.
dashboard.scheduleHint: Schedule a post to see it here

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Manage published and scheduled content across your connected channels.
posts.urlDescription: Required for analytics and comment classification.
posts.notFound: This post could not be found.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Performance metrics for your published posts.
analytics.mockNotice: Demo analytics · Values are generated for your published posts.
analytics.unavailableDescription: Sign in again to load your analytics.

analytics.noDataDescription: Use Refresh analytics once the published post link is ready.
analytics.fetchCommentsHint: Click 'Fetch Comments' to scrape and classify comments from the platform.
analytics.commentsReady: {count} comments fetched, classified, and added below.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Track work created from classified comments and leads.
tasks.unavailableDescription: Sign in again to load your follow-up tasks.
tasks.emptyDescription: Convert a classified comment or lead into a task to begin tracking it here.

calendar.title: Content calendar
calendar.description: Scheduled and published posts grouped by their saved publishing date.

social.description: Manage your connected social media channels
social.emptyDescription: Connect your social accounts to start publishing and managing your content from one place.
social.facebookDescription: Publish posts and engage with Facebook audiences.
social.instagramDescription: Publish visual content and engage on Instagram.

profile.title: Profile settings
profile.description: Manage your personal details, security, and account.
profile.nameHelp: 2–60 characters. Arabic and English names are supported.
profile.nameLength: Name must be between 2 and 60 characters.
profile.passwordHelp: 8+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, and a number.
profile.deleteDescription: All account access will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
profile.emailHelp: Changing email requires your current password.
profile.confirmEmailDescription: Enter your current password to change your email to {email}.
profile.passwordDescription: Confirm your current password and choose a secure new one.
profile.securityDescription: Sensitive changes require your current password and are processed through protected API routes.
profile.noAdminDescription: This workspace has no admin yet. Claim access to manage roles and tasks.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.description: This dashboard is not available for the current workspace role.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.description: Manage workspace users and roles, and review system activity.
admin.accessDescription: Full control for user management, role assignment, system configuration, and audit logs.
admin.manageUsersDescription: Invite members, assign one of the four dashboard roles, and review access.
admin.systemLogsDescription: Review important workspace, access, and configuration events.

cmo.title: CMO dashboard
cmo.description: Monitor account readiness, pipeline, conversion, campaign ROI, lifetime value, and executive alerts.
cmo.accessDescription: Read-only analytics with no operational or publishing actions.
cmo.accountScoresDescription: Average intent across the active account portfolio.
cmo.campaignRoiDescription: Pipeline return compared with tracked campaign spend.

marketing_manager.title: Marketing manager dashboard
marketing_manager.description: Prioritize scored accounts and leads, coordinate journeys, and manage nurture campaigns.
marketing_manager.accessDescription: Can view accounts, filter journeys, review scores and recommendations, prioritize leads, and run campaigns.
marketing_manager.recommendationDemoReason: High intent detected. Schedule a sales conversation.
marketing_manager.recommendationNurtureReason: Adoption is strong but stage is still Lead.
marketing_manager.prioritizeLeadsDescription: Focus the team on the people with the strongest buying signals.
marketing_manager.recommendedActionsDescription: Use account context to choose the next coordinated step.
marketing_manager.nurtureCampaignsDescription: Coordinate campaign activity for accounts that are not ready to convert.

social_media_user.title: Social media user dashboard
social_media_user.description: Manage daily social content and interactions across connected channels.
social_media_user.accessDescription: Tactical access for social conversations, content creation, scheduling, tagging, and intent flags.

monitor.title: Monitor comments and DMs
monitor.description: Review incoming conversations from connected social channels.

createSchedule.title: Create and schedule posts
createSchedule.description: Prepare content and select when it should publish.

reply.title: Reply to comments and DMs
reply.description: Continue customer conversations from the social inbox.

tag.title: Tag contacts and accounts
tag.description: Attach an interaction to the correct person or buying account.

flagIntent.title: Flag high-intent interactions
flagIntent.description: Escalate conversations that show meaningful buying intent.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: People who interacted with your social content.
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Comments will appear here.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Prioritize companies by buying-group readiness, intent, engagement, adoption, and revenue potential.

leads.title: Leads and decision-makers
leads.description: Score individuals without losing the account, role, and buying-group context around them.

journeys.title: Customer journeys
journeys.description: Compare person-led consumer journeys with account-led B2B journeys and coordinate the next action across teams.
journeys.b2bTitle: The account advances when the buying group is ready
journeys.b2bExplanation: The CMO, champion, daily user, and technical evaluator can move non-linearly. Their signals combine into account readiness.
journeys.consumerTitle: One person moves through a direct lifecycle
journeys.consumerExplanation: A consumer journey follows one identity from the first website visit through conversion, activation, and retention.
journeys.recommendedReason: Northstar Retail has high intent, three engaged buying roles, and a recent demo request.
journeys.supportReason: Namaa Health is highly adopted, but an active connection issue could delay full activation.

consumerHints.firstVisit: Capture source, campaign, and high-intent pages.
consumerHints.contentEngaged: Use social, email, and website behavior to personalize the next message.
consumerHints.signedUp: Connect the anonymous journey to the known user profile.
consumerHints.activated: Guide the user to the first meaningful product outcome.
consumerHints.retained: Monitor repeated value, support needs, and churn signals.

tasks.title: Team tasks
tasks.description: Assign a follow-up to a teammate and track every delegated task in one place.
tasks.taskTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Follow up with Northstar Retail

flagged.title: Flagged comments
flagged.description: High-priority comments across every connected channel - leads and complaints that need a fast follow-up.
flagged.emptyDescription: Comments classified as a lead or complaint will show up here for quick action.
